svg.text: 16380 games: every opening cell, every one of the 90 replies, depth 3 both sides. How often the opener wins when the second player answers the lantern.
When the second player takes it instead, the numbers are the exact complement, so that half of the study is not drawn here.
one number per cell, from its own 90 games
rotations of one opening averaged together: this is the signal
how often the opener wins, per cent
